findings.evidence: The sibling pattern exists: `generatedRootVector_def … := (rfl)` at RootWeight.lean:148 (and in E6 RootWeight.lean:173). Grep finds no `generatedCartanVector_def`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem generatedCartanVector_def (i) : generatedCartanVector R i = ⁅generatedRootVector R (.inl i), generatedRootVector R (.inr i)⁆ := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `generatedCartanVector` has an unexposed body and no `_def` lemma, so other files cannot recover that it is the bracket of the opposite root vectors; only this file can unfold it (line 87).

findings.fix: Add `theorem generatedCorootCocharacter_def (i) : generatedCorootCocharacter R i = (generatedWeightTorusCoordinateMap R).hom.cocharacter (Finsupp.applyAddHom i).toMultiplicative := (rfl)`.
findings.issue: `generatedCorootCocharacter` has an unexposed body and no `_def` lemma; the file unfolds it with `rw [generatedCorootCocharacter]` (lines 72, 134), but other files can only reach it through `_eq_namedCoroot`, which needs a validity hypothesis.

findings.evidence: The proof at line 171 uses `simpa only [tangentBasis, Module.Basis.equivFun_ofEquivFun]`, which unfolds the definition.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] tangentBasis_equivFun : tangentBasis.equivFun = tangentLinearEquiv` and `@[simp] tangentBasis_repr_apply` giving `algEquivSelf (d (single (ofAdd (single i 1)) 1))`.
findings.issue: `tangentBasis` is `Basis.ofEquivFun tangentLinearEquiv` with a hidden body, but no lemma states its `equivFun`/`repr`; `tangentLinearEquiv_symm_apply` (line 168) unfolds the definition to get it.

summary: Two new hidden-body definitions (`generatedCartanVector`, `generatedCorootCocharacter`) have no public defining equation, and the new split-torus basis has no lemma linking it to its coordinate equivalence.
